# Stellar Cleaning Solutions
> Owner-operated commercial and residential cleaning company based in Corvallis, Oregon, serving ten cities across the Willamette Valley and Central Oregon. Custodial and janitorial contracts, office cleaning programs, and residential cleaning. Background-checked, insured crews. Free estimates, no published pricing — every quote follows an on-site walkthrough. 4.7 stars across 53 Google reviews.

## Services
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/commercial-cleaning): Offices, retail, medical suites, warehouses, restaurants and post-construction cleanup, scheduled after hours or on weekends.
- [Residential Cleaning](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/residential-cleaning): Weekly, bi-weekly and monthly house cleaning, deep cleans, and move-in / move-out turnover cleaning.
- [Janitorial Services](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/janitorial-services): Ongoing custodial contracts with a dedicated crew, supervisor inspections, restroom restocking and floor care.
- [Office Cleaning](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/services/office-cleaning): Cleaning programs for professional suites through to multi-floor corporate campuses, run outside business hours.

## Service Areas
- [Corvallis, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/corvallis): Home base. OSU-corridor offices, downtown retail and South Corvallis residential.
- [Albany, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/albany): Historic downtown districts and the industrial corridor.
- [Lebanon, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/lebanon): Healthcare-adjacent facilities and small professional offices.
- [Philomath, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/philomath): Residential and small commercial, ten minutes from base.
- [Salem, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/salem): Government, professional services and healthcare, serviced after hours.
- [Eugene, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/eugene): The largest market served; offices, campus-adjacent property and rental turnover.
- [Springfield, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/springfield): Industrial, medical and shift-work facilities.
- [Bend, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/bend): Hospitality, short-term rental turnover and high-desert dust management.
- [Prineville, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/prineville): Facility-grade commercial alongside small-town residential.
- [Redmond, OR](https://stellarcleaningsolutionsllc.services/areas/redmond): Newer commercial space and post-construction cleanup.
